newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN STOCKS END FLAT ON NEW ACCOUNTS DAY.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN STOCKS END FLAT ON NEW ACCOUNTS DAY.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended almost flat on Wednesday as profit-taking towards the close offset early gains on new accounts day. Dealers said the index would slip further as the market was over-bought.

"Sentiment is weak. The index could dip another 40 or 50 points as the market is over-bought," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "Karachi Electric Supply Corporation rose sharply on hopes of its early privatisation."
The index fell 0.09 points, to end at 1,929.72. Losers led gainers 154 to 60. KESC rose 1.75 rupees to 31.25. PTCL fell 0.20 to 41.80. -- Amir Zia (9221) 5685192; Fax 5673428
